MODE 2-7: A·X^B

Power regression y = A·x^B.

keys
MODE→2→7

Positive-data scaling laws (log-log linear).

formula
y=A⋅xB

Power-law scaling. Both x and y must be positive; log-log looks linear.

steps

Open this type

  1. MODE→2→7
  2. Clear or edit data in the Statistics Editor as needed
  3. AC, then SHIFT 1 (STAT) for Var / Reg / MinMax recalls
